items.experience: How do you translate a fast-paced digital feed into a live, physical event? By keeping the audience constantly engaged. I led the creative vision to turn platform insights into a tangible experience. The venue was built around four interactive content zones, while the main stage featured a dynamic lineup that blended client-led video stories with an original interactive game show I developed specifically for the summit. To capture the authentic TikTok vibe, the entertainment had to be relevant and timely. We brought in Ness & Stilla for a live set right during their breakout year, and wrapped up the summit with a headline performance by Mergui.

items.experience: To bring the bootcamp concept to life, we built a location-specific experience right inside the VIP section of Bloomfield Stadium. The goal was to create an environment that felt tactical, focused, and ready for action. I directed the content and stage flow to ensure TikTok's strategic messaging was delivered clearly. We also integrated interactive activities throughout the day, turning theoretical platform updates into practical, hands-on tools that advertisers could immediately implement for the upcoming hot season.

items.experience: How do you make critical safety guidance feel calm rather than alarming? The entire piece was produced end-to-end with generative AI, building a soft, illustrative watercolor world that turns official shelter instructions into something human and reassuring. I directed the visual language, pacing, and on-screen messaging so the guidance reads clearly across the city's communities — keeping the tone approachable while the information itself stays precise and easy to follow.

items.experience: How do you design a company party that actually feels like a party? You embrace a bit of curated chaos. The creative concept for this event was intentionally eclectic, pulling inspiration from everything that brings joy, blending a touch of nostalgia with a healthy dose of general madness. As Creative Director, I shaped the content and stage direction to reflect this playful, unpredictable vibe. Instead of a traditional event flow, we created a vibrant, high-energy environment where the rules were left at the door, allowing the Lusha team to simply let go, be surprised, and celebrate together — just because.
items.kind: event concept · stage direction · content management

items.experience: To stand out on a crowded conference floor, you have to offer more than just standard company swag. I designed an interactive "phygital" (physical-digital) experience centered around a complex, professional coding riddle built specifically to challenge elite developers. We wrapped the entire activation in a heavy dose of 90s nostalgia, rewarding those who cracked the code with retro-inspired prizes. By gamifying the recruitment process and speaking directly to the developers' competitive edge and love for retro culture, we created a buzzing booth that successfully captured over 600 qualified leads.

items.experience: To keep the energy high and the learning hands-on, I designed a multi-layered environment that moved way beyond a standard keynote. We built three dedicated, interactive content rooms, each bringing TikTok's key summer verticals to life: Travel, Back-to-School, and the 4th of July. With the Olympics in the air, we wanted to take gamification to the absolute edge. We installed a physical 10-meter running track paired with a massive LED screen, allowing attendees to literally sprint head-to-head against Israel's national sprint champion. We created a VOD system with case studies videos on 20 vertical screens. We closed out the summit on a secondary stage with an unforgettable, high-energy performance by Hanan Ben Ari.
